positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Refined home valuation process by implementing an automated daily process that calculated absorption & percentile statistics for hundreds of home listings in central Texas (Apache Spark, Airflow, AWS EMR, Python, Postgres) 
• Created hardware view within internal dashboard that shows the state of each home's lock and Raspberry Pi (React, DynamoDB, Express) 
• Managed and improved reliability of all-day open house system (Raspberry Pi, Python, Docker, Home Assistant) 
• Worked with a variety of different languages, frameworks, and content management systems such as Javascript, React, Node.js, Python, Airflow, Spark, Postgres, Webflow
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Computer Science · Apache Spark · React Native · Amazon Dynamodb · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed web application features using React, Redux, Node.js, and Hapi.js
• Developed mobile application features with React Native and Redux
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · React Native · hapi.js · Node.js

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed internal bot tool that relayed Software Build information to developers through Microsoft Teams (C#)
• Designed Web Application that logged worker activity on software builds (Node JS, HTML, CSS)
• Created Outlook Add-In that held state of builds and showed current developer activity (C#)
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Bot Framework · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · SCSS · C# · HTML

positions.title: Peer Advisor | UT ECE
positions.description: Using familiarity with the UT Austin ECE Degree program, I help advise fellow students on courses, as well as the ins-and-outs of being an Electrical and Computer Engineering student at UT Austin. Provide information to prospective students and parents about UT's ECE department, and courses.

volunteerExperiences.role: Member At Large ('16-'17) | Third Year Representative ('17-'18)
volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Third-Year Representative on ECE Advisory board that strives to provide insight into ECE student concerns, as well as host and coordinate social events.
•	Previously the student lead for student-lead faculty interviews, creating connections between future ECE educators and students. 
•	Managed the Advisory Board website that can be found the here: https://www.undergradboard.ece.utexas.edu

As a group we hold Youth Empowering seminars ranging in various topics, including but not limited to healthy eating, choosing a career, and how to handle one’s finances. We are also heavily involved in the Community and participate in Community Service Opportunities such as Blue Santa, Capital Area Food Bank, and  sometimes collecting items for local nursing homes. In this club I have held the positions of Chaplain, Historian, and have served as President as well.

projects.title: chive
projects.description: Using Winamp to play the many music files stored on my computer was a pastime for myself “back in the day”. There didn’t seem to be an equivalent for MacOS on the market that combined some of Winamps main features (equalizer, playback speed) with a more modern interface.

projects.title: Achilles
projects.description: A tool that visualizes the output of the apollo-tracing extension. You can use it to understand the performance of your GraphQL api calls.

organizations.name: Robotics and Automation Society - The University of Texas at Austin
organizations.description:
- Developing robots using Keil, Stellaris Launchpad, Knowledge of C Programming and Mechanics
- Demobots:   Reconstructed old robots and developed new robots for campus events
- Robotathon: Competed in a rigorous semester-long competition to build an autonomous robot.
